sqlMap.select: SELECT RR.RETURN_ID, RR.ORDER_ID, RR.ORDER_ITEM_ID, RR.REASON, RR.STATUS, P.PRODUCT_NAME, U.USERNAME FROM RETURN_REQUESTS RR INNER JOIN ORDER_ITEMS OI ON RR.ORDER_ITEM_ID = OI.ORDER_ITEM_ID INNER JOIN PRODUCTS P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID INNER JOIN ORDERS O ON RR.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID INNER JOIN USERS U ON O.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE RR.RETURN_ID = #returnId#
SELECT RETURN_ID, ORDER_ID, ORDER_ITEM_ID, REASON, STATUS FROM RETURN_REQUESTS WHERE ORDER_ID = #orderId#

SELECT RR.RETURN_ID, RR.ORDER_ID, RR.ORDER_ITEM_ID, RR.REASON, RR.STATUS, P.PRODUCT_NAME, U.USERNAME FROM RETURN_REQUESTS RR INNER JOIN ORDER_ITEMS OI ON RR.ORDER_ITEM_ID = OI.ORDER_ITEM_ID INNER JOIN PRODUCTS P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID INNER JOIN ORDERS O ON RR.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID INNER JOIN USERS U ON O.USER_ID = U.USER_ID
RR.STATUS = #status#
RR.REASON LIKE #reasonKeyword#
O.USER_ID = #userId#
ORDER BY RR.RETURN_ID DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RETURN_REQUESTS WHERE STATUS = 'PENDING'
